title: How Often Do You Do It?
summary: Learn how to use words like always, usually, and never to talk about your daily habits. You will see where to put these words in a sentence.

sections.p: We use adverbs of frequency to answer the question 'How often do you do something?'. These words show how many times you do an action. From 100 percent to zero percent, the words change. We put these words before most normal verbs, like play, eat, or go. They help people understand your daily routine and habits very easily in conversation.

ex.en: I always drink coffee in the morning.
ex.mean: I do this every single morning without fail.
She does not eat meat at any time.

sections.p: Let us look at the list from most to least. Always means one hundred percent of the time. Usually means about eighty percent. Often means around sixty percent. Sometimes means fifty percent, or half the time. Never means zero percent. Knowing this order helps you talk about your schedule and hobbies correctly.

ex.en: We usually watch TV after dinner.
ex.mean: We do this on most days, but not every day.

ex.en: They sometimes play tennis on Saturdays.
ex.mean: They do this on some Saturdays, but not all.

sections.p: In a simple sentence, put the frequency word right before the main action verb. For example, say 'I often walk to work'. But remember the verb 'to be', like am, is, or are. When you use 'to be', the frequency word goes after the verb. For example, say 'I am always happy' or 'He is never late'.

ex.en: You are often late for class.
ex.mean: You are late on many days.
He almost never eats fast food.

tip: Draw a small ladder in your notebook. Put 'always' at the very top and 'never' at the bottom to remember the order easily!

quiz.ask: Choose the correct word for 100 percent
quiz.en: I ___ brush my teeth before bed.

quiz.ask: Choose the correct word for 0 percent
quiz.en: Fish can ___ fly in the sky.

quiz.ask: Choose the correct position with the verb 'is'
Choose the correct word for about 50 percent
Choose the correct position with a normal verb
quiz.en: We ___ go to the park on Sundays.

quiz.ask: Choose the correct word for about 80 percent
quiz.en: He ___ drinks tea, but sometimes he drinks coffee.
